headline: Quincy end Missouri S&T's perfect start
dek: Missouri S&T's unbeaten start ended at Quincy on Saturday, the first point they have dropped and only the second goal they have conceded all season. Quincy, held at home by Indianapolis in midweek, are the first side to keep them from scoring.
displaced_by: Missouri S&T lost at Quincy on 12 September, their first defeat and first dropped point

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-four goals exceed what the six lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them; the conference's scoring is one bar and then a slope.

wire.line: Missouri-St. Louis are the first side to score against Southwest Baptist this season, and they did it twice.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches past their date carry no published result: Drury's at home to Evangel and away at Wash U, Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan, and Lincoln's home match with McKendree, the one conference match of 9 September without a result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have won five and lost one, scoring fourteen and conceding four; the defeat was at home to Oklahoma Christian, and they have not dropped a point since.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: William Jewell have lost all five of their matches; Daniel Pirillo's goal at Indianapolis on Saturday was their first of the season, against nine conceded.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jake Offerman has made eighteen saves for Quincy and conceded three goals, with two clean sheets.

last_match.line: Quincy have not lost since the opening night at Wisconsin-Parkside.

next_match.line: Neither side has lost yet; Lincoln have drawn more often than they have won, and Southwest Baptist have scored in every match they have played.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
